violations.message: Presentation fixture coverage is incomplete: data-bearing steps `bun` have no representative fixture; referenced steps `bun` have no fixture-backed observation. Run the play once and copy the intended observation from `.rote/presentation/<run-id>/input.json` (`steps.<name>.outcome.output.body` for a single output), then place only representative evidence under the fixture directory and declare it in `presentation_fixtures:` under `resources/presentation-fixtures/`. Fixtures require a dedicated `<play>/main.ts` package. See `rote guidance play testing` for the evidence and fixture lifecycle.
